# Tra Khmer Dictionary API

> JSON REST API for Khmer to Khmer (Choun Nath) and English to Khmer (SBBIC) dictionary lookups. Requires a free token.

- [Full documentation (Markdown)](https://tra-api-v1.vercel.app/docs/Tra-API.md): endpoints, parameters, examples, errors
- [Documentation (PDF)](https://tra-api-v1.vercel.app/docs/Tra-API.pdf): same content as a PDF
- [OpenAPI spec](https://tra-api-v1.vercel.app/docs/openapi.json): machine-readable schema
- [Contact for the full word database](https://t.me/Tradev14): Telegram
- [Get a token](https://tra-api-v1.vercel.app/developers): menu > API for Developer > Create API
